items.title: Italian Wine Exports Slip 6.2% Amid Global Headwinds
items.summary: Italian Wine Union (UIV) Observatory data shows Italy’s total wine exports dropped 6.2%, to just over €3.6 billion, in H1 2026.

items.title: US Spirits Maker Sazerac Launches Takeover Bid For Germany's Berentzen
items.summary: US spirits maker Sazerac has launched a takeover offer for all shares of beverage firm Berentzen for €5.55 apiece.

items.title: Les Mousquetaires Invests €5m To Boost French Beef Sector
items.summary: Les Mousquetaires has launched an initiative to counteract the decline of French cattle farms and safeguard food sovereignty.

items.title: New Balance takes Decathlon to court over logo: K or N?
items.summary: New Balance has filed a lawsuit against the French sports retailer Decathlon. The logo on the Kiprun running shoes is said to resemble the American shoe manufacturer's iconic "N" too closely.

items.title: How Ferrero is strengthening sustainability from farm to factory
items.summary: Ferrero advances sustainability with 98% cocoa traceability and major emissions cuts across plants.

items.title: Italy And Albert Heijn Bring Authentic Flavours To Dutch Tables
items.summary: Italy’s Foreign Trade Institute (ICE) has launched a strategic partnership with Dutch supermarket chain Albert Heijn.

items.title: Delhaize Boosts Belgian Fruit & Vegetable Consumption Via New Initiative
items.summary: Delhaize Belgium has launched an initiative to strengthen its fruit & veg offering, as few Belgians eat the recommended amounts.

items.title: [In the picture] Beauty brand Cent Pur Cent aims to build awareness with a flagship store in Antwerp
items.summary: The skincare brand Cent Pur Cent opened a flagship store in Antwerp on Saturday, September 19. This is only the brand’s second store—the first being in Hasselt—and its products are available at more than 1,000 pharmacies in Belgium and online.

items.title: Maple Leaf Foods Relaunches Yves Veggie Cuisine Across Canada
items.summary: Canada’s Maple Leaf Foods has acquired and brought back plant-based food brand Yves Veggie Cuisine, following consumer demand.

items.title: DIA Rolls Out Online ‘Gluten-Free’ Mode, As Offer Surpasses 1,000 SKUs
items.summary: Spanish chain DIA has rolled out a dedicated gluten-free mode across its website and app, to streamline shopping for consumers.

items.title: Greggs Bakery Chain Opens Bitesize Outlet In London Tesco
items.summary: Popular British bakery and fast-food chain Greggs has opened its Bitesize format inside a supermarket for the first time.

items.title: Why functional nutrition calls for a closer look at flavor
items.summary: From energy to protein, fiber and beyond, targeted wellness calls for a more intentional approach to flavor.
